ITEM 1 | Roughly 10-12 small, rounded, chunky pieces, dark reddish-brown to mahogany, with a matte-to-slightly-glossy surface and some darker browned patches; several cut faces show a lighter tan interior; pieces are about 2-3 cm across and 1.5-2 cm tall, clustered in the left half of the plate, covering roughly 25% of the plate area | 120

ITEM 2 | Smaller round slices and pieces, light tan to golden-brown with darker edges, slightly crumbly looking, about 1.5-2.5 cm across, scattered among the cluster on the left side of the plate | 35

ITEM 3 | About 35-40 whole almonds, pale tan with a smooth, slightly matte skin and fine ridges, roughly 2.5 cm long and 1.5 cm wide, dry-looking with no sheen, arranged in a loose fan covering roughly 25% of the right side of the plate | 60

ITEM 4 | About 12 small, smooth, oval, dark red to purple-red grapes with a glossy, slightly wrinkled skin, each about 1.5-2 cm long, clustered in a loose group at the bottom center of the plate | 45

ITEM 5 | One single pale yellow-green oval grape with a glossy, smooth skin, about 2 cm long, sitting separately below the red grape cluster | 5
